summary: Frontend adds a new Worker0-only stocks hook/parser and wires AssetSearch to use it, and removes marketCap-based sorting for stocks. Backend shows new types/storage fields for a raw Worker0 validation record and still contains legacy multi-endpoint/chunk URL constants, but the diff summary does not include concrete evidence of the required permission-gated fetch/query methods or the single-outcall fetch/store implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a permission-gated update method that fetches `api.assetsbag.com/stocks.json` in a single HTTP outcall (no batching/chunking) and stores the raw response body as-is, plus a permission-gated query method to read the latest stored validation/inspection record (requestedUrl, timestamp, rawResponseBody, validationStatus, errorMessage, isTruncated), without using the existing 16-chunk/64-call pipeline.
missing_requirements.reason: Although backend types and a `stocksRawVPS1ValidationResult` variable are shown, the diff summary is truncated and does not show the actual update/query method implementations, permission checks, or the outcall logic demonstrating a single-request fetch and storage of the inspection record.

missing_requirements.requirement: Stocks loading UI copy no longer references merging 4 VPS endpoints and no longer implies chunked fetching.
missing_requirements.reason: AssetSearch.tsx is truncated before the Stocks-specific loading/error UI text is visible, so the diff summary does not provide evidence that the user-facing copy was updated for the Stocks path.

hallucinated_features.description: Added marketCap-based sorting for Crypto assets in `useAssetSearch` (sort applied when marketType === crypto).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only required removing marketCap-based sorting for Stocks; it did not request adding or changing sorting behavior for Crypto.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a debugging/inspection React hook `useGetStocksWorker0ValidationResult` for directly querying the raw Worker0 validation result.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focused on updating Add-Asset search to use the new backend flow; it did not explicitly request an additional frontend debug/inspection hook.
